request: a simple interactive ascii color mixing engine
thesis: Colour is mixed out of text: every glyph is a coloured cell, and the mix is something you can watch happen, character by character, and then read as a hex code.
job: add a drop of a pigment (or take one away)
watch the mix change in the ascii bowl
switch the mixing model (paint vs light) and see the difference
read the resulting colour: hex, rgb, parts
keep a mix as a swatch and bring it back

principles: direct manipulation: click the thing to change the thing
every input has visible, immediate output
undoable: a remove and a reset always exist
tricks: keyboard shortcuts printed next to the control
show the parts as a bar so ratios are readable without maths
animate the change so the cause is visible
tests: can a stranger mix orange in two clicks
does every click change something visible

principles: averaging sRGB values directly is wrong for light; use linear light
weighted geometric mean of rgb approximates subtractive paint
steps: convert to linear or log space
tricks: blue + yellow = green only under the subtractive model
white lightens without changing hue; black darkens
red + green is yellow in light, mud in paint
tests: equal parts of one pigment returns that pigment

principles: density ramp maps lightness to glyph
monospace grid with fixed cell size
colour carries the hue, glyph carries the texture
steps: pick a glyph per cell from noise and lightness
tricks: per-cell jitter makes the mix look stirred
tests: text stays crisp on a dark ground

principles: one state object, one render function
pre elements or spans in a monospace grid
tricks: build the grid as rows of spans, update style.color only
tests: phone width has no horizontal scroll

expectations: result is visibly the mix of what was added

kinds.name: drop mixer
kinds.what: click pigments to add drops; the bowl shows the blended colour

kinds.name: slider mixer
kinds.what: one slider per primary, bowl follows

kinds.name: stir canvas
kinds.what: drag across a glyph field to smear colours into each other

descriptions: each pigment has a glyph letter and a colour
behaviors: shift-click or minus removes one part

descriptions: grid of about 40 to 56 columns by 12 to 18 rows
cells ease toward the target colour so the mix visibly flows
behaviors: new pigment drops show as a ripple from a point

anti_keywords.not: a colour picker with sliders only
anti_keywords.instead: ascii is the display, everything is glyphs

anti_keywords.not: simple means no history, no palettes import/export, no saving to storage, no gradients editor
plain rgb averaging as the only model

anti_keywords.instead: bowl animates its change then rests
dark ground so the coloured glyphs glow

checks: yellow + blue in paint gives a green
red + green in light gives yellow
no horizontal scroll at phone width
